bio: Head to Roswell to find this gem, located inside a converted home, then step inside for Southern charm at its very best. It's packed with a host of well-heeled guests, all chatting and celebrating.Chef Woolery “Woody” Back mans the stoves in a kitchen that focuses on seasonal, elevated Southern food. Cornbread or hogs 'n quilts make for ideal openers, but if you're leaning into the seasons, opt for dishes like asparagus bisque, a piping hot bowl of spring-minded goodness. Fried chicken brims with flavor and is impossibly delicious, and it's a good thing the portion is overly generous, as you'll want to tuck into leftovers later. Mac and cheese or collard greens make for perfect partners on the plate....
